g.text: Each cell is that desktop's placement map,
read from the engine. Current outlined blue,
3 px rects, 1 px outline sampled from the rail
by the rect's own x, 40% fill when occupied.
Calendar, weather and media obey it too.
The desktop itself shrinks into its cell in
280 ms and grows back out of the cell you
click. No UI element ever scales.
phosphor-motes drift sparsely on the void
ground between cells. Non-current cells sit
Hover a cell: its outline enters white, focus is never a hue. Click: the grid releases and that desktop scales up to fill the screen.

svg.text: Phosphor · dashboard · every desktop's placement map, calendar / weather / media in the same grammar
